description: This file defines the Configuration class within the AWS SDK for PHP, particularly related to retry strategies. It handles validation and storage of configuration parameters such as mode and maxAttempts.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Represents the retry configuration with options for mode and maximum attempts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Configuration object, validating 'mode' and 'maxAttempts' parameters.

methods.name: getMaxAttempts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of retry attempts.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
